# Lanesra OS

Lanesra OS is a modern, open-source sales and business management application for small businesses.

## Current status

- Early Access v0.9.0
- Browser-based live demo is available
- Windows desktop edition is in early development: the source is public today (Tauri + Rust + SQLite) with the full sales lifecycle, Contracts, Tasks, user management and a Team Workspace mode for small teams (Docker) all working. No packaged installer is published yet - build and run it from source, or build one yourself via the repo's CI workflow.

## Core capabilities

- Companies and contacts
- Opportunities and sales pipeline
- Products and services
- Quotes, orders and invoices
- Contracts
- Tasks and activities
- Sales dashboards
- Connected relationship validation
- Automatic record numbering

## Product principles

- User ownership of business data
- Offline-first desktop direction
- Connected records instead of duplicated free text
- Simplicity before feature volume
- Open-source transparency
- Modern, accessible product design
